findingDuringBuild.id: false-positive needle on the pack's own name
findingDuringBuild.what: The record-value exclusion scan was first written as bare /plate/i and went RED on every camera record. The hit was `template-city`: the letters p-l-a-t-e sit inside the word template.
findingDuringBuild.whyItMatters: The obvious repair is to exclude cityKey from the scan, and that exclusion would have been the real hole — the next lane adds a field, the needle never sees it, and the gate reads green forever. Fixed by word-bounding every needle instead, which keeps every field in scope. Same defect class as a scan that reads a comment as code (DEV_PROCESS 2.2), and it was caught only because the scan was run rather than assumed.
findingDuringBuild.state: fixed on the branch; the reason is written at the constant so it is not re-broken

adversarialReviewAtCp2.checked: Did adding four domains make the ungranted state unreachable?
adversarialReviewAtCp2.result: No. spireon stays off template-city's demonstration axis, patrol-vehicles still composes `ungranted`, and each of the four new domains is additionally proven to reach `ungranted` on a probe pack that grants it nothing. 7 of 8 registered domains carry records on template-city; the 8th is the exemplar.

adversarialReviewAtCp2.checked: Is `fixtureGrants` growth a feed connection in disguise?
adversarialReviewAtCp2.result: No. grantedAdapters is [] on all three shipped packs and assertCityPackShape refuses any grant on a generating pack. No network call, no vendor endpoint, no sourceUrl exists anywhere on this branch. The existing assertion proving grantedAdapters is empty was left untouched rather than adjusted.

adversarialReviewAtCp2.checked: Do the extras assert figures rather than count them?
adversarialReviewAtCp2.result: No. Every extra on all four domains is computed by filtering the returned record array, and four reconciliation tests sum each dimension back to recordCount. call-analytics is the sharpest case: answered and abandoned are drawn independently and offered is their sum, so the per-record identity is capable of disagreeing.

adversarialReviewAtCp2.checked: Does the money rule survive the one domain that would break it?
adversarialReviewAtCp2.result: Yes. The CIP register carries no figure at all; the absence is written positively on every record (budgetBasis) and declared in RECORD_SHAPES.powerbi as a required:false `budget` field with its reason. The seam's money guard is the second control, not the first.
